classification.difficultyReason: Use a prime factorisation systematically to obtain all 24 factors without omissions.

content.prompt: Find the prime factorisation of $360$, and use it to write down all $24$ factors of $360$.

answer.short:
$360=2^3\times3^2\times5$.

The factors are $1,2,3,4,5,6,8,9,10,12,15,18,20,24,30,36,40,45,60,72,90,120,180,360$.

Form products using up to three factors of $2$, two factors of $3$ and one factor of $5$.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}360&=36\times10\\360&=2\times2\times3\times3\times2\times5\\360&=2^3\times3^2\times5\end{align*}$$

Use each of $1,2,4,8$ with each of $1,3,9$. This gives the factors containing no factor of $5$:

$1,2,3,4,6,8,9,12,18,24,36,72$.

Multiplying these by $5$ gives the remaining factors:

$5,10,15,20,30,40,45,60,90,120,180,360$.

There are $4\times3\times2=24$ possible products. In increasing order, all factors are:

$1,2,3,4,5,6,8,9,10,12,15,18,20,24,30,36,40,45,60,72,90,120,180,360$.
